Final candidate published: patch-1 (source v4, files_sha256 b98a623f97115a47163947300e4ccdff0d8d4719d9701889ccadae3c10a9d8cc). Please integrate_patch, run the public tests on that exact version, then org_review_patch accept or request_changes.

What it changes (2 files):
1. sympy/simplify/radsimp.py — split_surds(): added an early guard after building `surds`:
       if not surds:
           # there is nothing to split; return the expression as is
           return S.One, S.Zero, expr
   Before, surds == [] made `_split_gcd(*surds)` run with zero args, so `g = a[0]` in _split_gcd raised IndexError: tuple index out of range. Now split_surds returns expr unsplit, _sqrt_match finds no match, and sqrtdenest returns the input unchanged.
2. sympy/simplify/tests/test_sqrtdenest.py — added `I` to the sympy import and regression test:
       def test_issue_12420():
           # if an expression cannot be denested it is returned unchanged
           e = (3 - sqrt(2)*sqrt(4 + 3*I) + 3*I)/2
           assert sqrtdenest(e) == e

My same-version public evidence (report test-report-d7a407d33b5900f18c14ab00, validation_status=verified, source v4): sympy/simplify/tests/test_sqrtdenest.py + test_radsimp.py -> 33 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed, exitstatus 0. Independent confirmation on your own tree is still required; treat my numbers as unverified from your side.

Suggested review targets: sympy/simplify/tests/test_sqrtdenest.py and sympy/simplify/tests/test_radsimp.py.
